# pangolin_resource_rule (Resource)

An access rule on a Pangolin resource: allow, block or pass matching requests by CIDR, IP, path, country, ASN, region or HTTP method. Rules are only evaluated when the resource has `apply_rules` enabled. Import using the format `<resource_id>:<rule_id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_resource_rule.example 5:12`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Block destructive HTTP methods from outside the office network.
resource "pangolin_resource_rule" "no_writes" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.resource_id
  action      = "DROP"
  match       = "METHOD"
  value       = "POST,PUT,PATCH,DELETE"
  priority    = 10
}

# Let the office network through first.
resource "pangolin_resource_rule" "office" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.resource_id
  action      = "ACCEPT"
  match       = "CIDR"
  value       = "203.0.113.0/24"
  priority    = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) What to do with matching requests: ACCEPT, DROP or PASS (fall through to the resource's normal authentication).
- `match` (String) What the rule matches on: CIDR, IP, PATH, COUNTRY, COUNTRY_IS_NOT, ASN, REGION or METHOD. METHOD requires Pangolin 1.24 or later.
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation order; rules with a lower number are evaluated first.
- `resource_id` (Number) ID of the resource the rule belongs to.
- `value` (String) Value to match, interpreted according to `match`: a CIDR (`10.0.0.0/8`), an IP, a URL glob (`/admin/*`), a two-letter country code, an ASN (`AS13335`, or `ALL`), a region ID, or a comma-separated list of HTTP methods (`POST,PUT,DELETE`).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `rule_id` (Number) Pangolin-assigned rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_resource_rule.example 5:12
```
